name: mnemcik
description: Personal Claude Code plugin marketplace — custom skills and MCP plugins.

plugins.name: triage
plugins.description: Iteratively process a list of items one by one — PR review comments, code review findings, analysis results, Jira issues, or any batch of questions/decisions that need individual attention

plugins.name: independent-review
plugins.description: Independent, fresh-context review of a PR, branch, design, analysis or document: pinned version, read-only reviewers, every finding validated, coverage recorded, delta re-review until clean.

plugins.name: analysis
plugins.description: Pick up one backlog item with a decision-ready analysis: validated problem, cited evidence, one recommendation with alternatives, an independent review, every open decision listed. Never implements.

plugins.name: pr-workflow
plugins.description: Rules for agents working on issues and pull requests: habits for any PR the session opens, the author role and the maintainer-side intake in configured repos, and a hook that names the rules before the first gh call to a configured repo.
